search_intent: Compare FOB and CIF quotations for Chinese vehicles imported into a Southeast Asian country
editorial_angle: Southeast Asian FOB and CIF comparisons should include country permits, transshipment, feeder or inter-island delivery, port charges and first registration.

sources.title: Incoterms 2020 Checklist and Flowcharts
sources.supports: FOB and CIF for maritime delivery and the relevance of FCA or CIP for containerised and multimodal carriage.

sources.title: Establishing the Customs Value
sources.supports: Singapore-specific vehicle transaction valuation, freight and insurance additions, conditions for using transaction value and alternatives; different acquisition scenarios for used vehicles.
sources.verification_scope: Read the current page reached from Singapore Customs' Importing Vehicles and Boats index. The article does not publish a numerical valuation or tax rate.

sources.title: Guide to Importing Dutiable Motor Vehicles
sources.supports: Singapore vehicle customs-value assessment, approval, duty and GST permit, port clearance, and referral to LTA for registration. Customs clearance is not itself permission for road use.
sources.verification_scope: Read the current guide reached from the official Singapore Customs index. Applies to Singapore only.

sources.title: Procedures on Importation and Registration of a Car
sources.supports: A destination-specific example linking vehicle approval and registration to import evidence.

sources.title: Approved Permit Application of Personal Vehicles
sources.organization: Ministry of Investment, Trade and Industry of Malaysia
sources.supports: Malaysia's destination-specific Approved Permit application for personal vehicle imports.

sources.title: ASEAN Guidelines on Light Electric Vehicles
sources.supports: Differences among ASEAN member states in vehicle approval, charging, battery performance, testing and related standards.

evidence_gaps: ASEAN guidance does not create one vehicle import, customs, steering-side, approval, charging or registration system; the exact national authority must confirm the offered variant.
Feeder, ferry, inter-island, terminal, storage, inland, dangerous-goods and banking charges vary by country, island, carrier and shipment date.
A CIF named seaport does not prove delivery to an inland or island destination, nor continuous insurance after discharge.
Preferential origin, if claimed, requires an applicable agreement and valid product-specific evidence and cannot be inferred from shipment from China or an Incoterm.
Electric, used, damaged or repaired vehicle acceptance, battery state and ferry rules require written confirmation from the actual carrier and destination authorities.

editorial.purpose: Help international vehicle buyers make safer, evidence-led sourcing decisions.

evidence.note: No first-hand inspection, transaction, interview or ownership claim is made.
